ASML · ASML-EUR-dated2025-central-2026-10-18-v4

December 31, 2025 financial, capital and discount origin; information through October 18, 2026. Retrospective conditional research, not an as-known-at-origin backtest or a current stock valuation. Current equity and current-price comparisons are blocked.

ASML uses nominal EUR operating cash flows, EUR discount rates and EUR claims. Nasdaq ASML is a USD-quoted New York registered ordinary share, equivalent to one ordinary share, not an ADR. The separate USD illustration uses only the December 31, 2025 ECB reference of 1.175 USD per EUR. EUR statements are never relabeled USD.

FY2026 revenue of 44,455.4 million combines reported nine months and fourth-quarter guidance midpoint; it is not a full-year actual. EUV, other systems and installed-base revenue are distinct components. FY2027 growth assumptions are 25%, 10% and 12%; FY2028: 20%, 10% and 10%. Revenue reaches 69,170.1 million in 2030, above the older management opportunity range: an analyst judgment, not a new issuer target. Capacity is not guaranteed recognized sales. Growth fades to 2.5% in 2035.

Economic margins already include a recurring 1.009473% future-grant cost, based on 2025 gross grant values. The USD grant leg uses a 2025 average-FX proxy, separate from the dated share conversion. FY2026 replaces estimated amortized SBC in guidance-derived EBIT; later margins hold residual costs including D&A and expensed R&D fixed. The 215 million legacy expense is deducted and reversed equally, giving zero uplift. Existing awards dilute once; future grants are not diluted again. Cash ESPP retention bonuses remain operating costs.

Net investment includes PPE and intangibles minus operating D&A, positive incremental working capital and net strategic supplier funding. FY2026: 1,900 + 180 − 1,050 + 1,768.215 + 600 = 3,398.215 million EUR. The first seven years have explicit components; final three years transition to terminal capital retention. Strategic Zeiss loans/advances fund operations and are not surplus cash. Historical CFO less capex is not unlevered FCFF.

Opening customer advances of 19,372.6 million EUR remain constant in the base: new-order deposits replace releases on delivery, without an extra growth-cash credit. The 50% and 100% runoff stresses add fixed cash uses of 1,937.26 and 3,874.52 million in each of years 1–5, respectively. Revenue and margins stay unchanged, so these are funding stresses, not full downturn scenarios. Runoff is operating investment, never another debt claim. Its amount and years do not scale with capital multipliers or stretch with the horizon.

The nominal EUR WACC is 10%, fading to 8%. October 16 ten-year Bund yield 3.42%, adjusted ERP 4.42% and January equipment-industry beta 1.39 provide dated context. Risk overlay, leverage, credit spread and mature beta are analyst assumptions. October rates are used in the retrospective December-origin case; no market quote was fitted.

Operating tax is 17% through 2028, rising to 25.8%; the innovation-box agreement is not assumed permanent. Opening tax liabilities of 669.6 million are deducted once and current tax asset recovery of 88.9 million credited once. These settlements are excluded from forward FCFF. Noncurrent DTA of 1,719.4 million has zero separate credit; adding it without removing overlapping tax-rate benefits would double count.

Terminal policy is 2.5% nominal growth, 39.609801% economic margin, 25.8% tax, 25% incremental ROIC and 8% WACC. Investment equals NOPAT × growth / ROIC, or 10% of NOPAT. The final explicit year and terminal FCFF both grow 2.5%. No extra customer-advance growth windfall is added.

Cash and short investments total 13,321.9 million EUR, less a 3,000 million analyst liquidity reserve. Private-equity book value 1,320.7 receives a 20% haircut; Zeiss ownership uses an 822.6 book proxy because associate income is outside operating EBIT. Debt uses 3,590.8 bond fair value + 691.7 commercial paper + 16.4 mortgage, not book debt again. Finance leases 16.5 and net interest swaps 47.9 are deducted once. Common shares 385.417665 million plus conditional awards 0.778707 and old options 0.010122 give 386.206494 million units. Options use full-share dilution with zero exercise proceeds, not fair option value.

The liquidity reserve, private-investment haircut, associate value, tax recovery and award vesting remain conditional proxies. Customer advances are operating funding, not debt; the reserve does not replace runoff analysis. Operating leases and FX derivatives remain operating. Deferred-compensation assets and liabilities are both excluded, omitting their 2.2 million net surplus. Private-investment realization tax and contingent losses are not appraised; the extra claim starts at zero as an explicit assumption. Unbounded controls have no claimed maximum loss.

No distribution calibration is established. All Monte Carlo defaults are fixed and Run is manual. Named runoff stresses and 0.75%/1.5% future-grant sensitivities are analyst sensitivities without probabilities. Simulation remains in EUR; the dated USD translation is separately labeled. Blank selected claims block shareholder allocation while valid operating value remains available.

Curated FY2016–2025 US GAAP history is in EUR. FY2016–2017 use restated comparatives and corrected debt classifications. Normalized EBIT removes co-investment R&D income in 2016/2017 and the 213.7 million disposal gain in 2021; raw reported EBIT and field-level provenance remain available. IFRS interim earnings are not spliced into US GAAP. Missing early lease amounts stay unknown. Reviewed scope is selected financial statements and disclosures, not every historical filing end to end.

ASML · ASML-EUR-dated2025-central-2026-10-18-v4

财务、资本及折现基准日为 2025 年 12 月 31 日，信息截至 2026 年 10 月 18 日。这是回溯条件性研究，不是基准日当时已知信息回测，也不是当前股价估值。当前股权价值及当前价格比较已禁用。

ASML 采用名义欧元经营现金流、欧元折现率及欧元请求权。纳斯达克 ASML 是以美元报价的纽约登记普通股，每股对应一股普通股，并非 ADR。单独的美元示例仅使用 2025 年 12 月 31 日欧洲央行参考汇率：1 欧元＝1.175 美元。欧元报表不会被重新标为美元。

2026 财年收入 444.554 亿欧元由已报告九个月业绩及第四季度指引中点组成，并非全年实际值。EUV、其他系统及装机基础收入分别建模。2027 年增长假设为 25%、10%、12%；2028 年为 20%、10%、10%。2030 年收入达到 691.701 亿欧元，超过较早的管理层机会区间；这是分析判断，不是公司新目标。产能不等于有保证的已确认销售。增长至 2035 年递减至 2.5%。

经济营业利润率已包含持续的 1.009473% 未来授予成本，依据 2025 年授予总价值。美元授予部分使用 2025 年平均汇率代理，与日期对应的每股换算分开。2026 年以经济薪酬替换指引推导 EBIT 中估计的摊销股权薪酬；后续利润率固定包含折旧摊销及费用化研发的残余成本。2.15 亿欧元旧奖励费用等额扣除并转回，不提高价值。现有奖励仅稀释一次；未来授予不再另计稀释。ESPP 现金留任奖金仍列经营成本。

净投资包括固定资产及无形资产支出，减经营折旧摊销，加正向增量营运资本及净战略供应商资金。2026 年：1,900＋180－1,050＋1,768.215＋600＝3,398.215 百万欧元。前七年有明确分项，后三年过渡至终值资本保留政策。向蔡司提供的战略贷款／预付款属于经营投入，并非多余现金。历史经营现金流减资本开支不等于无杠杆 FCFF。

基准情景的期初客户预付款 193.726 亿欧元保持不变：新订单定金补足交付时结转金额，不另计增长现金收益。50% 及 100% 流失压力分别在第 1–5 年每年增加固定现金使用 19.3726 亿及 38.7452 亿欧元。收入和利润率不变，因此它们是融资来源压力，并非完整下行情景。预付款流失计入经营投资，不再列为债务请求权。其金额和年份不会随资本乘数缩放或随期限延展。

名义欧元 WACC 为 10%，递减至 8%。10 月 16 日德国十年期国债收益率 3.42%、调整后股权风险溢价 4.42% 及一月设备行业贝塔 1.39 提供有日期的参考。风险加项、杠杆、信用利差及成熟期贝塔属于分析假设。十月利率用于十二月基准日的回溯案例，未拟合市场股价。

经营税率至 2028 年为 17%，随后上升至 25.8%，不假设创新税收协议永久延续。期初税款负债 6.696 亿欧元仅扣除一次，流动税款资产回收 8,890 万欧元仅计入一次；这些结算不再进入未来 FCFF。非流动递延所得税资产 17.194 亿欧元不单独加值；若不移除已包含在税率中的重叠利益便加值，会重复计算。

终值政策为 2.5% 名义增长、39.609801% 经济利润率、25.8% 税率、25% 增量 ROIC 及 8% WACC。投资＝NOPAT×增长率／ROIC，即 NOPAT 的 10%。最后明确年度与终值 FCFF 均增长 2.5%。不额外增加客户预付款增长收益。

现金及短期投资合计 133.219 亿欧元，减去 30 亿欧元分析流动性储备。私募股权账面价值 13.207 亿欧元折价 20%；蔡司持股采用 8.226 亿欧元账面代理，因为联营收益不在经营 EBIT 中。债务采用债券公允价值 3,590.8＋商业票据 691.7＋按揭 16.4 百万欧元，不再加账面债务。融资租赁 1,650 万及净利率互换 4,790 万欧元各扣除一次。普通股 3.85417665 亿股，加条件奖励 77.8707 万及旧期权 1.0122 万股，得 3.86206494 亿分配单位。期权按完整股数稀释且行权收入为零，并非期权公允价值。

流动性储备、私募投资折价、联营价值、税款回收及奖励归属仍是条件性代理。客户预付款属于经营融资来源，不是债务；储备不能替代流失分析。经营租赁及外汇衍生品维持经营处理。递延薪酬资产与负债均排除，未计其 220 万欧元净盈余。私募投资实现税及或有损失尚未估值；额外请求权以零开始是明确假设。无上界控件不代表最大损失已知。

尚未建立分布校准。蒙特卡洛默认值全部固定，须手动运行。命名预付款流失压力及 0.75%／1.5% 未来授予敏感性均属未赋予概率的分析敏感性。模拟保持欧元，日期对应的美元换算单独标示。选定请求权留空时会阻止股东分配，但有效经营价值仍可显示。

经整理的 2016–2025 财年 US GAAP 历史以欧元计量。2016–2017 年采用重述比较数据及修正债务分类。规范 EBIT 移除 2016／2017 年共同投资研发收益及 2021 年 2.137 亿欧元处置收益；原始报告 EBIT 及逐字段来源仍可查。IFRS 中期利润不会拼入 US GAAP。早期缺失租赁金额保留未知。复核范围为选定财务报表及披露，并非逐份通读所有历史文件。
